title: Supplementary material for: Every distance-conversion table has a range of validity — how the half-to-full marathon relationship changes with finish time, sex and race context in 34,139 finishes at Japanese marathons
description: Derived summaries, figures and analysis code (Code S1, Tables S1–S5, Figure S1) for the article submitted to Translational Exercise Biomedicine. Race results and individual finisher records are not included; data sources are listed in the README. Code is released under MIT, tables/figures/text under CC BY 4.0.
